summary: Remove all .pak files after the folder loader passes
author: pm
body:
Remove every `.pak` under `staged/` and `tools/display_id_manager/sprites/` with `git rm` (part of HH-0055). Do this only after the folder loader passes the in-game check and the pak_extract `--verify` comes back clean. Then run deploy `--dry-run` to confirm the old paks leave `game/client/sprites`.

**Done when:** no `.pak` is tracked, deploy removes the deployed copies, and the game runs.

Source: user, 2026-11-24: "Fix the client and remove the pak files".
